slides.title: Looking at a Laval plex? Learn these 5 terms.
slides.sub: The numbers behind every listing, from Chomedey to Laval-des-Rapides.

photo.credit: Near Av. Léo-Lacombe, Laval · Photo: Elli, CC0, via Wikimedia Commons

slides.title: MRB: price vs. gross rents
slides.body: **MRB** = price ÷ yearly gross rents. At the same price, more rent means a lower MRB.
slides.source: Per Centris, last 4 quarters to Q3 2026

slides.title: Operating costs come off the top

photo.credit: Boulevard René-Laennec, Laval · Photo: Gaétan Veillette, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons

slides.body: Taxes, insurance, heating you pay, repairs, and an allowance for empty units. Ask for real bills, not estimates.

slides.title: NOI: what the building earns
slides.body: **Net operating income** leaves the mortgage out. It shows what the building earns on its own.

cards.title: Gross rents
cards.sub: All units, for a full year

slides.title: Cap rate (TGA): NOI ÷ price
slides.body: That example gives **4.6%**. The $40K is made up, just to show the math.
slides.source: Price per Centris, last 4 quarters to Q3 2026

slides.title: Cash flow: after the mortgage
slides.body: What's left is your **cash flow**. Ask your mortgage broker to run real payment numbers.
